newsitem.title: INDIA: India allocates 973,000 tonnes wheat for May sale.
newsitem.headline: India allocates 973,000 tonnes wheat for May sale.

text.p: The Indian government has allocated 1.28 million tonnes of rice and 973,000 tonnes of wheat for sale in May through its public rationing system, the Food Ministry said on Tuesday.
The government had allocated 1.29 million tonnes of rice and 971,000 tonnes of wheat for sale in April.
The ministry said in a statement that wheat allocation in May had been maintained at a high level to ensure adequate supplies.
